01

Four useful links open missing pages

The homepage doctor button and three treatment links lead to HTTP 404 pages instead of useful provider or service information.

  • Add the four exact permanent 301 redirects in the recommended map below; review the broader team/hub fallbacks before implementation.
  • Make all five page-level link edits too: link directly to live destinations, remove two redundant self-links, and review the featured-doctor wording.

02

Fix only the broken schema fields

The affected Product blocks contain symbolic offer prices and unescaped newlines in reviewBody; removing offers alone leaves the JSON invalid in three freshly checked examples.

  • Remove only the invalid offers / AggregateOffer object, not the whole Product or accurate Service, business and doctor schema.
  • Generate reviewBody with proper JSON escaping so its line breaks are valid; check the remaining JSON after both changes.
Fresh source + local parser experiment · not a Google test screenshot
Original affected scope: 26 treatment URLs
Fresh checks: Dental Implants, Invisalign and Specialty
offers: AggregateOffer · price: $$-$$$ · no numeric lowPrice
Original: invalid control character in reviewBody
Offers removed alone: still invalid JSON
Offers removed + reviewBody escaped: valid JSON in all 3 examples
Remaining schema preserved; this is not a live rich-result verdict
Example: Dental Implants
03

Mobile downloads a hidden desktop video

The homepage downloads ashburn-hero-video.mp4 on mobile even though its video container is hidden, wasting 5.29 MB—about 69% of the measured page transfer.

  • Prevent the desktop video's source and autoplay from initializing on mobile; keep the existing static mobile photo.
  • Retest a cold mobile load and confirm the MP4 no longer downloads; hiding it with CSS or preload=none alone is not enough.

04

The mobile photo makes the text jump

The first-screen family photo has no reserved dimensions, pushes the text down 273 pixels when it loads, and is the LCP element in mobile lab runs measuring 6.87–8.51 seconds.

  • Reserve the photo's 5:4 space with width/height or aspect-ratio, keep it eager, and give this actual LCP image high fetch priority.
  • Retest layout shift and LCP after changes; the small photo is not a large-file compression problem.

05

Two service cards have no clickable route

The homepage's Periodontics and Specialty cards show useful service information but hide their Learn More buttons, leaving both cards without a usable link.

  • Show the Learn More buttons and point Periodontics to /periodontics/ and Specialty to the existing /specialty/ hub.
  • Correct the hidden Family Dentistry placeholder links and check both cards on desktop and mobile; noindex alone does not prevent using a helpful page.

Fix order

Repair broken journeys and malformed markup, then fix the two measured mobile defects and missing card links.

  • First: approve mapped destinations, repair links, remove invalid offers and escape the review text.
  • Next: stop the hidden mobile video, reserve photo space, expose service-card links, and retest.

Read-only website audit, October 2, 2026. Mobile lab runs: 37–43/100; desktop: 76/100. Field CWV/INP unavailable. Screenshots are real; the photo pair is a labeled controlled diagnostic. Correct GBP hours, geography-related booking errors, clinical claims and backlinks are excluded. No website changes; implementation tickets are separate.
